subject: Pre-interview warmup + accessibility ops — Maya Singh
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.example>
Date: 2027-08-15T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Pre-interview warmup and accessibility ops — Maya Singh

Hi team,

We have Maya Singh (candidate) for SWE II scheduled today. Key ops items I want to lock down so the day runs smooth for her (she has some sensory sensitivity and prefers a short warmup):

Agenda overview (panel starts 1:00 PM PT):
- 12:30 PM PT: 20-minute warmup call (1:1 with recruiter) — quick intros, confirm audio/video, ask for any last-minute accommodations.
- 1:00 PM PT: Panel — 60 minutes (system design + behavioral + product sense)
- 2:10 PM PT: Debrief (panelers stay muted, short score collection)

Ops asks:
- Quiet room reserved on-site in Building A, Room 3B for candidate check-in and warmup (Rafael — can you confirm escort + sign-in?)
- ASL interpreter request submitted (attached). If vendor confirmation comes through, interpreter should join panel over Zoom as a co-host so Maya can see interpreter and panelists.
- Live captions: please enable LiveCaption link for the Zoom meeting.
- Scribe: request a note-taker (internal) to capture rubric highlights.
- Panel host permissions: enable screen sharing and breakout (Jordan will use a digital whiteboard).

Zoom warmup link (use for both warmup and panel — we will admit Maya from the waiting room):
https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=Warmup123
Calendar invite: https://redwood.gcal/invite/7b3f1a

Attachments:
- [Attachment: maya_singh_resume.pdf (PDF)]
- [Attachment: interpreter_request_form.pdf (PDF)]

Rafael — would you lead a 1–2 sentence role intro at the top of the panel and confirm quiet-room escort?
Jordan — please confirm you'll need screen control for the whiteboard and whether you prefer a second monitor.
Kimberly — can you follow up with LiveCaption and confirm interpreter name/time?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pre-interview warmup and accessibility ops — Maya Singh

Thanks Marissa — got it. Quick ops update: 

- Quiet room A3B reserved and facilities notified; front desk will meet Maya at the lobby and escort her to A3B at 12:20 PM. I'll be there to greet.
- Scribe: I've asked Pri (internal) to cover note-taking; she'll join as a panelist but stay muted except to type notes.
- AV check: I ran a quick audio/video test in A3B; the room has a secondary monitor for panel screen-sharing.
- I'll open the Zoom meeting at 12:15 PM and admit Maya from waiting room for the warmup; warmup will be on the same link to reduce context switching.

Attaching a short day-of checklist for the front-desk and A3B volunteer.

[Attachment: day_of_ops_checklist.txt (TXT)]

Kimberly — let me know interpreter confirmation and arrival ETA and whether interpreter will be on-site or remote.

Rafael Mendes

Quick note — I'll be using my MacBook Pro. For the system design portion I'll want to share FigJam (or a whiteboard) and give control to the candidate if needed. Could you please: 

- Make me a co-host so I can assign remote control to the candidate if we decide to try a sketch exercise.
- Enable the breakout room option, just in case we split for the final 10 minutes.

Also, small ask: if Maya prefers, we can avoid asking her to switch cameras mid-panel. We'll keep her on the same device for consistency.

Hi Maya — looking forward to speaking in ~1.5 hours. A few quick items to make today comfortable: 

- Warmup 12:30 PM PT (20 min) — same Zoom link we'll use for the panel: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=Warmup123
- Please join from whichever device you prefer; we will keep you on that device throughout the panel to minimize changes.
- If you need a quiet space when arriving on-site, we have Room A3B reserved and a front-desk escort will meet you at the lobby at 12:20 PM.
- An ASL interpreter (Priya Desai) will be on the panel and LiveCaption will be available. If you prefer any other accommodation, reply and I'll make sure it's arranged.

Agenda (again):
12:30 — 12:50 PM PT: Warmup (Marissa)
1:00 — 2:00 PM PT: Panel (Rafael/Jordan + interviewers)
2:10 PM PT: Quick debrief and next steps

Attachments: Maya, your resume is attached for reference.

See you soon — reply if anything changes.
